page.overview:
Who is Ballideci?

Ballideci is a Tilean sea captain who commands a merchant ship of fifty tons.

His ability to maneuver his ship to escape customs officials and other pursuers is legendary.

He's a distant cousin of the hero Castavelli, the man who recently ventured into the green hell known as Lustria.
